messages.text: Make a meme using this cat pic.

Can you make a meme using this attached cat pic? I’ve had one of those weeks where I keep getting the day wrong, so this feels very relatable. I want it to be square, with the top text saying exactly “WHEN YOU THINK IT’S FRIDAY” and the bottom text saying exactly “BUT IT’S ONLY TUESDAY”. The cat’s expression is what made me want to do this in the first place. Please use big white letters with black outlines, and keep the cat’s eyes clear.

Add big bold white Impact-style capital letters with thick black outlines. Top text, in one or two lines across the very top edge of the image, above the cat eyes: WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY. Bottom text, across the very bottom edge of the image: BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY. Spell the text exactly as written. No text may cover the cat eyes or face. No other text.
